messages:
micah: Need a new GPU node pool in southamerica-east1 for nightly batch rerank jobs. Traffic spikes ~02:00 UTC. Can we carve out capacity with preemptible GPUs? Quota is probably the blocker.

sarah: How many GPUs and what card? H100 quota there is usually 0. T4/A10 tradeoffs? Also what's the min/max nodes you want?

micah: Rough estimate: 40 concurrent workers, ~1 GPU per worker, jobs ~2m each => ~40 GPUs at peak. Thinking n1-standard-16 + T4, 4 GPUs/node => need max 10 nodes. Want autoscaler fast for the batch window.

devon: Agree on T4 for cost. Add taint so non-gpu pods don't land: `gpu=true:NoSchedule`. Don't forget GPU device-plugin daemonset and tolerations on the job pods.

kai: Pod startup time will bite us (model downloads). Options: pre-pull images with a DaemonSet or keep a warm node (min 1). Also set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.

micah: Ok then set min=1, max=10. Plan: node pool preemptible T4s + a tiny non-preemptible fallback pool for critical jobs.

quota-bot: Project quota (southamerica-east1): GPUs total quota=12, used=4, available=8.

sarah: We only have 8 GPUs free — short of 40. Either request quota increase or split across regions. Routing to us-west2 is an option but adds complexity.

devon: Two options: (A) request +40 GPU quota increase (B) hybrid: 8 local T4 preemptible + burst to us-west2 when over 8 using smart routing. For (B) need cross-region network checks and data locality for model artifacts.

micah: I'm filing the quota ticket now. Meanwhile, propose autoscaler flags: `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m`, `--scale-down-delay-after-add=2m`, `--max-node-provision-time=15m`, and enable `balance-similar-node-groups`. Also use node labels to track cost center.

kai: +1 on `max-node-provision-time=15m`. Add PodDisruptionBudgets for critical pods and increase pod retries — preemptible eviction will happen. Also set `max-graceful-termination-sec` for our model servers.

ops-bot: Support request created: #5698 (GPU quota increase). Estimated response time 72h.

sarah: While we wait, can we spin up a tiny non-prod pool with 2 A10 (non-preemptible) nodes to validate infra and CI? They cost more but unblock testing.

micah: I'll create a small node pool (min=0 max=2) with two A10s for smoke tests, and add the T4 preemptible pool once quota is approved.

devon: Remember to set node labels `cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool` and `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type`, taint `gpu=true:NoSchedule`, and add tolerations to the batch job spec. Also add cost-center annotation so billing reports pick it up.

ell en: Also add readinessProbe that checks model is loaded before traffic. Use lifecycle preStop to gracefully flush in-flight requests on eviction.

micah: Thanks all — I'll push a terraform plan with two node pools (preemptible T4 pool + small non-preempt A10 test pool), autoscaler config, taints/labels, and a short playbook for warm nodes. Pinging @capacity-team for approval :thumbsup:

micah: gcloud snippet I'll use for the T4 pool: ```
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-t4-preemptible \
  --cluster=prod-cluster \
  --region=southamerica-east1 \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=4 \
  --num-nodes=1 \
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=10 \
  --preemptible \
  --node-labels=pool=gpu-t4,env=prod \
  --node-taints=gpu=true:NoSchedule
```

micah: Will follow up with Terraform diff and the support ticket link.
